entities.name: ACC carboxyltransferase beta/alpha
observations: Strong sequence match to reviewed bacterial acetyl-CoA carboxylase carboxyltransferase beta/alpha proteins; top hit identity 56.0%, query coverage 99.5%, E-value 1.34e−210.
Homology-supported role: carboxyl transfer from carboxybiotinyl-AccB to acetyl-CoA, producing malonyl-CoA (EC 2.1.3.15; Rhea RHEA:54728).

Homolog annotations place the protein in cytoplasmic acetyl-CoA carboxylase and fatty-acid/malonyl-CoA biosynthesis; zinc binding is reported for reference homologs, not directly demonstrated for this query.
